Quiz: Ezra Reads the Law Story Quiz
Question: How did the Levites help the people as the Law was read?
OptionA: They sang while Ezra read silently
OptionC: They read only the first chapter
OptionD: They read distinctly and gave the sense, so the people understood
Explanation: They read in the book of the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused the people to understand the reading.
